component.name: Crunchyroll
component.summary: Unofficial Linux desktop client for Crunchyroll with Widevine DRM, Auto-PiP and MPRIS

description.p: Crunchyroll Desktop (Unofficial) is a free, open-source Linux desktop and HTPC client for streaming Crunchyroll with built-in Widevine DRM playback via Castlabs Electron and a custom glassmorphic dark interface.

ul.li: Smart Auto-PiP (F10) and Floating Mini-Player (F9) that preserve styled anime subtitles
Linear 20% to 100% see-through player translucency across Wayland and X11
In-player Video Quality selector (Q), Sleep Timer (T), and timeline chapter markers
Self-healing PipeWire audio recovery across long pauses, Bluetooth switches, and sleep/wake
Native GNOME MPRIS media keys, Watchlist, Custom Crunchylists, and frame capture (Ctrl+Shift+S)

description.p: Graceful offline startup, static AppImage runtime, and AppStream metadata for AppImageHub.
Long-pause and sleep/wake PipeWire audio recovery, star ratings, and movie playback support.
